sourceAuthority: Original governed source material in authenticated project Drive
invariants: Every admitted design alternative or changed owner-approved architectural geometry receives a NEW stable edition ID and NEW immutable source-backed model/manifest path.
Previously published model/manifest files and prior edition IDs remain selectable and unchanged; preserve Git history and PRE/POST evidence.
Original DWG/DXF/PDF and private engineering Docs remain authoritative at their existing Drive locations; only public-safe verified derivatives may be published in CAD.
Do not generate an edition for a UI/theme/renderer/coordinate-overlay improvement, an Actions deployment, an M-series engineering checkpoint, a document revision or a purely administrative release.
All five chapters and all floor/phase views refer to the selected edition; URL parameter edition must restore the same edition and avoid substituting a different project model.
Engine, schema, template and visual categories are updated ONCE in the shared CAD library and inherited by all registered projects; do not clone another project's building geometry.
Source-only and pending-project adapters remain genuinely source-only or unknown; no placeholders asserted as surveyed or approved structure.
Browser-local edit/request histories are not a new published edition. A reviewed PR with model/source files, provenance and CI is necessary to create a new public selection.
Every new edition records project/edition ID, predecessor, source family, source revision/hash where publicly permitted, creation reason, validity/approval status and a cross-floor impact review.
Validate existing versions and all affected project adapters before merge; require exact main-commit Actions + Pages deployment + independent live readback before immutable milestone tag/release.

editionKinds.meaning: A distinct preserved building design snapshot with source-supported geometry
A source-supported conceptual building alternative, independent of shared software version
A named current or historic original drawing/revision family; not automatically a model edition
Deliberately empty fictional starter with no admitted geometry

localRequestFlow.record: Browser local history (not GitHub and not original source)
localRequestFlow.handover: Copy local change request / edit log with selected project ID, baseline edition ID and source references
localRequestFlow.admit: Create new immutable project model/manifest when supported; independent source/geometry QA and reviewed PR
localRequestFlow.register: Insert distinct edition option into west-rail selector with predecessor and new source reference
localRequestFlow.release: Validate all shared project pages; merge; Pages and readback; tag engine/release separately from design edition

separation.designEdition: Actual project-specific source/design alternative or changed geometry; appears in west selector
separation.sourceRevision: Underlying surveyed/drafted source revision or current family; may appear in selector only as explicitly source-family
separation.documentRevision: Stable native provider ID with R-sequence and verified archive, not an architectural edition
separation.engineeringCheckpoint: M/R/QA milestones and review evidence, not a design edition
separation.engineRelease: Shared renderer, interface or template version, not an architectural edition
separation.milestoneRelease: Immutable Git tag and release documenting the verified repo state; no invented architectural geometry

requiredActions: CAD Main GitHub Pages (validated CAD publishing)
